requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Bottles with High Page Yield
requirements.Description: Develop new NGB keyed ink bottles with 6,000-page yield for black and CMY, and increased bottle size for CMY (>8,000 pages).
requirements.Rationale: To meet market demand for higher capacity and reduce frequency of bottle replacement, supporting cost efficiency and user convenience.
requirements.Dependencies: Ink system compatibility, bottle design, supply chain adjustments
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Bottles are available in both 6K (Black/CMY) and >8K (CMY) capacities, function reliably with the printer, and pass yield and quality testing.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Reliability for Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Ensure new ink bottles and refilling system are designed for spill-free operation during user handling and servicing.
requirements.Rationale: Spill-free operation improves user experience, reduces mess, and minimizes warranty claims due to ink spills.
requirements.Dependencies: Bottle and ink tank interface design
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Refilling process must pass defined spill-free reliability tests in lab and field trials.

requirements.Title: NOA-F with Metal Foiled Labyrinth and Lid Label
requirements.Description: Implement NOA-F (Next-Gen Output Assembly-Filter) with a metal foiled labyrinth and lid label, with no change to click-on push-push and TDF mechanism.
requirements.Rationale: Improved reliability and traceability for service and warranty support.
requirements.Dependencies: NOA-F component sourcing and assembly process
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F units must include metal foiled labyrinth and lid label, and maintain compatibility with existing push-push and TDF mechanisms.

requirements.Title: Reuse of SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie Ink
requirements.Description: Leverage existing SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie pigment inks without ink reformulation for Magellan.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces R&D cost and time, ensures proven reliability and performance.
requirements.Dependencies: Compatibility testing with new system components
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie inks are validated for use in Magellan with no reformulation.

requirements.Title: Reliability and Characterization Modeling
requirements.Description: Conduct full reliability, WVTR (Water Vapor Transmission Rate), air gain, flow rate, and IDS (Ink Delivery System) characterization and modeling, including startup and NOA-F EOL (End of Life).
requirements.Rationale: Ensures robust system performance and supports warranty/service claims.
requirements.Dependencies: Test infrastructure, access to new components
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Comprehensive reliability and characterization reports completed and reviewed before launch.

requirements.Title: Ink Stability Modeling
requirements.Description: Model ink stability in the tank and assess impact on print quality (PQ).
requirements.Rationale: Ensures consistent print quality and prevents ink degradation over product life.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink stability model completed, with recommendations implemented if PQ risks are identified.

requirements.Title: NOA-F as Service Parts for Warranty Support
requirements.Description: Provide NOA-F as service parts to support in-warranty repairs and replacements.
requirements.Rationale: Improves serviceability and reduces downtime for end users.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F service parts available in distribution and listed in service manuals.

requirements.Title: Acumen 6 on Lid
requirements.Description: Integrate Acumen 6 (traceability/serialization solution) onto the lid of the relevant component.
requirements.Rationale: Supports traceability for quality and warranty management.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Lid includes Acumen 6 traceability feature and is readable in manufacturing and service environments.

requirements.Title: Factory Line Modifications for NOA-F and Ink Cart
requirements.Description: Modify existing SA14 production line for NOA-F and add Magi ink cartridge and labeling tool in Orcus 5.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures manufacturing readiness for new components and packaging.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SA14 and Orcus 5 lines modified and validated for new products before mass production.

requirements.Title: New Keyed Caps for Bottles
requirements.Description: Design and mold 1 to 4 new keyed caps for ink bottles to ensure correct installation and prevent cross-contamination.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents user errors and maintains system reliability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All new bottles use keyed caps, and installation errors are reduced to below defined threshold in validation testing.

requirements.Title: Support Customer-Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: Enable end users to replace PHA (Printhead Assembly) and NOA-F components without technician intervention.
requirements.Rationale: Improves serviceability, reduces downtime, and lowers service costs.
requirements.Dependencies: Design for user access, documentation, packaging
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PHA and NOA-F replacement can be completed by users following instructions, with success rate above 95% in usability testing.

requirements.Title: Warranty Page Life Goal of 80,000 Pages
requirements.Description: Set and validate a new warranty page life goal of 80,000 pages for the product.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with new service and customer expectations for durability and value.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product passes life testing with at least 80,000 pages printed without major failures.

requirements.Title: Support for SKU 2 (Hi + Hi PDL) PaaS
requirements.Description: Enable support for SKU 2 (High + High PDL) as a Platform as a Service (PaaS) offering.
requirements.Rationale: Expands business model flexibility and addresses new customer segments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SKU 2 available for PaaS with defined service and support structure.

requirements.Title: Size Increase for Tank and Input/Output Tray Alignment
requirements.Description: Increase tank size and adjust input/output trays to align with tank protrusion and optimize overall size.
requirements.Rationale: Accommodates higher ink volumes and maintains ergonomic design.
requirements.Dependencies: Tank and tray redesign, mechanical integration
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer accommodates larger tank and trays are aligned, passing ergonomic and capacity validation.

requirements.Title: 4.3” CGD Display
requirements.Description: Integrate a 4.3-inch CGD (Color Graphic Display) into the printer control panel.
requirements.Rationale: Improves user interface and accessibility for advanced features.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 4.3” CGD display fully functional and passes usability and reliability testing.

requirements.Title: Leverage Sayan Sibstar Tubes and New Tube Routing
requirements.Description: Use Sayan Sibstar tubes and implement new tube routing and integration for ink delivery.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures reliable ink flow and supports new tank design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink delivery system uses Sayan Sibstar tubes and meets flow/reliability targets.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management
requirements.Description: Update service station with aerosol management features and adapt spit platform due to tank changes.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces maintenance needs and supports new tank configuration.
requirements.Dependencies: Service station redesign, aerosol capture validation
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Aerosol management system implemented and passes emissions/maintenance tests.

requirements.Title: Carriage Dynamic and Force Model with New Weights
requirements.Description: Update carriage dynamic and force models to account for new tube routing and increased component weights.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures print quality and mechanical reliability with new system configuration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Updated models completed and reviewed, with no negative impact on print quality or reliability.

requirements.Title: Paper Path Supports Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Redesign paper path to support increased page life target (80,000 pages).
requirements.Rationale: Ensures reliability and reduces paper jams over extended product use.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paper path passes life testing and supports 80,000-page warranty goal.

requirements.Title: Ink Maintenance as Serviceable Part Post-80K Life
requirements.Description: Design ink maintenance as a serviceable part for replacement after 80,000-page life.
requirements.Rationale: Supports extended product use and reduces total cost of ownership.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink maintenance part can be replaced post-80K pages, with instructions provided.

requirements.Title: New IDS Make-Break and FI Connection
requirements.Description: Implement new make-break and FI (Fluidic Interconnect) connection in IDS (Ink Delivery System), leveraging LEBI ink-tank with increased size, keying, and LOI One SHAID.
requirements.Rationale: Improves system reliability, prevents leaks, and supports new bottle/tank design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: New IDS connections validated for reliability, leak-proofing, and compatibility with new tanks.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Develop new IDS startup algorithm and air management system to improve reliability and ink flow.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces startup failures and ensures consistent print quality.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: IDS startup passes all reliability and performance tests under defined conditions.

requirements.Title: New Print Quality Goals and Depletion Definitions
requirements.Description: Define new print quality (PQ) goals and depletion metrics to align with revised page yield targets.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures customer expectations are met for print performance and yield.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PQ goals and depletion definitions documented and validated through testing.

requirements.Title: Reuse Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, Raccoon PSU
requirements.Description: Leverage existing Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, and Raccoon PSU in Magellan design.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces development cost and leverages proven hardware.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: dASIC, aASIC, and PSU reused without modification and validated in system tests.

requirements.Title: Stingray Wi-Fi Module and Dune Firmware
requirements.Description: Integrate Stingray Wi-Fi module and Dune firmware for connectivity and device control.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures up-to-date wireless connectivity and firmware management.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Wi-Fi and firmware features validated in field and lab tests.

requirements.Title: Gauss4.xx Security (HW & FW)
requirements.Description: Implement Gauss4.xx security features in both hardware and firmware.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances device security and compliance with enterprise requirements.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Security features pass internal and external security audits.

requirements.Title: EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel Compliance for PDL SKU
requirements.Description: Ensure product meets EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel eco-label requirements for PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: Supports environmental goals and regulatory compliance for target markets.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product certified for EPEAT3, LOT4, Blue Angel prior to launch.

requirements.Title: EPS Foam Packaging
requirements.Description: Use EPS foam packaging for product shipment and protection.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures safe transport and reduces damage during shipping.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: EPS foam packaging passes drop, vibration, and environmental tests.

requirements.Title: Business Model and Solution Support
requirements.Description: Support multiple business models (Consumer, SMB, Enterprise) and solutions (Scan solution, SMB manageability, Enterprise support: WJA, HPSM, JAM).
requirements.Rationale: Increases market reach and addresses diverse customer needs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All business models and solutions supported and validated in pilot deployments.

requirements.Title: Client and Driver Compatibility
requirements.Description: Ensure compatibility with HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, and UFD clients and drivers.
requirements.Rationale: Seamless integration into existing IT environments and support for all user types.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All listed clients and drivers fully functional with Magellan in system testing.

requirements.Title: Schedule Adherence for S’27 Launch
requirements.Description: Adhere to defined schedule checkpoints for hardware, NOA-F, and bottle development, ensuring S’27 launch.
requirements.Rationale: Critical to meet market timing and revenue goals.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All scheduled checkpoints met on time with required deliverables.

requirements.Title: SuperAmp PHA Life at 65K Constraint
requirements.Description: Constrain SuperAmp PHA (Printhead Assembly) life to 65,000 pages for this program.
requirements.Rationale: Defines service intervals and warranty coverage for key component.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp PHA consistently meets or exceeds 65,000-page life in validation tests.

requirements.Title: Warranty Life of 2 Years or Page Life Goal
requirements.Description: Optimize for a warranty life of 2 years or 80,000 pages, whichever comes first.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns warranty with market expectations and supports product positioning.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product warranty is clearly stated and supported by reliability data.

requirements.Title: Throughput Target of 25/20 PPM (PDL)
requirements.Description: Optimize product for a throughput target of 25 pages per minute (ppm) for standard and 20 ppm for PDL (Page Description Language).
requirements.Rationale: Competitive performance in target segments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Throughput validated at 25/20 ppm in standard and PDL modes in lab testing.

requirements.Title: Serviceability of Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Optimize design for easy serviceability of the maintenance box.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces service costs and improves customer satisfaction.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box can be serviced/replaced in under defined time by users or technicians.

requirements.Title: SMB Solution Support
requirements.Description: Support SMB (Small and Medium Business) solutions as part of the product offering.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses needs of key market segment and increases adoption.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SMB solutions available and validated with Magellan in pilot testing.

requirements.Title: PaaS Schedule Optimization
requirements.Description: Optimize schedule to support Platform as a Service (PaaS) offering for Magellan.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with business model evolution and customer demand.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PaaS offering available at launch, with schedule milestones met.
